notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator – Patch 0.2.3
notes.content:
Another step forward in building your dream arcade! Patch 0.2.3 brings new décor options, a brand-new shelf system for gachas, and a host of important fixes to make your arcade run smoother. This is the biggest update to the demo we've made so far. 
[hr][/hr]✨ Major Features🪩 Wall Décor – Lighting
Brighten up your arcade! You can now customize and add lighting décor to make your store stand out even more.
🗄️ Display Shelf System
Showcase your prized gachas! Players can now display gachas on shelves, and customers will buy directly from them when interested.
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Minor Fixes & Improvements
Tutorial & UI

Fixed tutorial arrow not working properly for Buy & Unlock Ninja Fighter and Gacha Ball.

Tutorial overlapping on the Pause Menu resolved.

Added Mini-Game Instructions throughout the game (including end-of-day repair mini-game).

Move hover graphics to a layer below tablet apps.

Furniture App description now uses a plain font and includes proper product screen layout.

Added descriptions for machines and furniture.

Store name now appears in the Reviews App.

Balance on Purchase Screen now updates correctly (previously showed 000).

Purchase screen shopping label made a universal size.

Fixed purchase screen negative balance: now shows red text with “–” sign instead of brackets.

Options menu now has proper SFX button clicks.

Pricing App (16:10) alignment fixed.

Added price change arrows to the Pricing App and Set Price window.

Pricing screen now shows gacha elements.

Furniture App alignment adjusted and vertical scroll bar added.

Customisation screen text (walls & floors) is now white, with reduced button UI text size.

Walls & Floors customization now support horizontal scroll wheel.

Delivery notification properly aligned for 16:10 aspect ratio.

Display shelf description text fixed.

Display shelf slot highlight is no longer visible from far away.

Gacha thumbnail resize fixed in Set Price window.

Neon Light price updated to 100.

Display Shelf price updated to 200.

Gameplay

NPCs will not interact with a machine while the player is using it (e.g., gacha).

Customers waiting in line now leave after an hour instead of standing forever.

Customers will now wait until repairs are finished before lining up again.

Fixed issue where too many dissatisfied customers appeared.

If player has 2 counter tables, Redemption UI now works correctly.

Redemption zoom bug (camera zooms into monitor when inserting tickets) fixed.

Redemption NPC dialogue made generic, and NPC dialogue text reduced to 70% size.

When second counter table is removed, customers no longer walk to it.

Sell product now shows price properly (Sell for XYZ).

Next Day Delivery text notification fixed.

After dropping delivery boxes, hover contents no longer remain visible.

Daily Report screen now shows correct bought items (includes gacha balls, vending machine sodas, display shelf gachas).

"Items Bought" text updated to "Items bought by customer".

Systems & Balance

Added Dynamic Prices for all machines via City Layout Scene_Manager_MarketPrices.

Progressive unlock system for Furniture App items.

Online Shop:

Shipping will no longer auto-select the first option on first purchase.

Divide license costs by 10 for all items.

Divide refill license costs by 10.

Changed “Express” shipping to 15%.

Fixed online shop purchase screen text issue.

Reduced Redemption customers on Day 1 & 2 (and later).

When buying from online shop, shipping no longer auto-selects the first option.

Interactions & Mini-Games

Added SFX for soda refill.

Added feedback text when pressing Repair.

Repair mini-game instructions appear properly at end of day.

Mini-games now have blur levels consistent with the gacha screen.

Updated cleaning mini-game model.

Mini-game SFX added.

While holding a box and hovering over a display shelf, pressing R no longer incorrectly opens the Display Shelf collection app.

Holding a refill box now shows quantity hover UI.

Display Shelf:

When placing a gacha, price defaults to empty.

Box-up shelf disabled if a gacha is already present.

Other Fixes

Customisation screen walls & floors text now white, with scroll support.

Changed UI to prevent tablet, hover effects, or head movement while Day End Report screen is open.

Fixed bug where pressing space bar with gacha app open spawns extra gacha balls.

Updated Retail Revamp UI.
[hr][/hr]🔜 Coming in Patch 0.2.4
Claw Machine Gameplay & Collection Feature

Storage Expansion

Storage Rack System to organize delivery boxes
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator Demo – Patch v0.2.2
notes.content:
Hey Arcade Managers!

We’re back with Patch v0.2.2, building on the repair and customization features introduced last update — plus tons of polish and community-requested bug fixes.

Let’s dive into what’s new!
[hr][/hr]🛠️ New Features
🧩 New Repair Mini-Game
One more way to keep your arcade machines in top shape! Enjoy a fresh new interactive repair mechanic that keeps maintenance fun and engaging.

🏠 Store Customization (Floors & Walls)
Give your arcade its own personality! You can now customize the floor and wall styles to match your vibe and create the perfect arcade ambiance.
[hr][/hr]🧰 Minor Fixes & Improvements
✨ Added Repair Particle Effects to make repairs feel more satisfying.

🎮 Mini-Game SFX — Repair and cleaning mini-games now come with sound effects for a better feel.

🧽 Updated Model for Cleaning Mini-Game for a cleaner, more polished experience.

📋 Instructions for Mini-Games have been added to help players understand what to do.

🎟️ Redemption UI Fix — If you have two counter tables, the UI now correctly appears and functions.

🛑 Box Pickup Movement Bug — Fixed issue where picking up boxes moved the player unexpectedly.

🔁 Repair Progress Saving — Your repair progress now saves properly, even between sessions.

🧍‍♂️ Customers Standing at Removed Counters — Customers now stop visiting counters that have been removed. No more ghosts!

🍹 SFX Added for Soda Refilling

🖱️ Fixed Tutorial UI from the Purchase Screen behaving incorrectly.

🔍 Fixed a ticket counter zoom-in bug on Day 2 where clicking would result in a strange close-up.
[hr][/hr]🔮 Coming in Patch 0.2.3
Here’s what’s on the way next:

🖼️ Wall Décor: Add posters, lighting, and more decorative elements.

🕹️ Support for More Machine Types: Car racing, dance machines, and more.

🤝 2-Player Machine Support: Including Air Hockey and 2P arcade cabinets.

🚧 Fix for Counter Table Clipping Through Walls
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for all your feedback — every message and bug report helps shape the game into the ultimate arcade sim. Stay tuned for more fun soon!

👉 Join our community on Discord:
🔗 https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx

See you in the next update! 💥

notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator Demo – Patch v0.2.1
notes.content:

🥤 Added more SFX:

Can filling sounds

Trash can sound effects

General arcade interaction audio polish

🎟️Can work with 2 counter tables to redeem prizes

🪙Increase speed of coin collecting.
[hr][/hr]🔮 Coming Soon in Patch 0.2.2

🏢 Store customization with flooring and wall options.

🖼️ Wall décor: Posters, lighting, and more ways to make your arcade your own!
[hr][/hr]
Thanks for sticking with us on this journey — each update is shaping Arcade Management Simulator into the ultimate arcade tycoon experience. Keep your feedback coming!

👉 Join the community on Discord:


🔗 https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx



More updates coming soon — see you in the arcade! 🎮

notes.title: 🕹️ Arcade Management Simulator Demo – Patch v0.2.0
notes.content:
🎉 First Major Feature Update!
Hey Arcade Managers!

We're excited to roll out Patch v0.2.0, the first major feature update for Arcade Management Simulator! This update marks a big step forward — laying the foundation for deeper mechanics, smarter systems, and a more rewarding player experience.

From financial control through loans, to a fully reworked retail and shipping system, this patch opens up new ways to grow, customize, and fine-tune your arcade empire. Let's dive in!
[hr][/hr]🚀 Major New Features
🏦 Bank Loan App
Need a cash boost? Take out loans from the bank to upgrade, expand, and dominate faster. But be careful — interest adds up!

🌟 Customer Reviews System
Your arcade is now under the spotlight! Customers leave reviews that influence foot traffic — better service = more customers!
Check out all the feedback in the new Reviews App.

📦 Advanced Shipping System
The online shop now features three shipping options:

Instant Delivery (costly but immediate)

Regular Delivery (balanced)

Next Day Free Delivery (budget-friendly, but delayed)
This adds a strategic layer to inventory planning and arcade stocking.
[hr][/hr]🧰 Minor Fixes & Improvements
🖥️ Fixed online shop UI scaling on different resolutions.

🚶‍♂️ NPC Walking Animation Fix

⚖️ Rebalanced machine and item pricing to feel more realistic.

🗑️ Fixed hover glyphs not showing above regular trash cans.

🧾 Pricing app now stays open unless intentionally closed — clicking inside won’t auto-close it.

🕒 Fixed issue where if you redeemed tickets right before a customer leaves, the next customer’s pointer glitched.

🎁 Redemption prize numbers now round off correctly.

🥤 Updated refill dialogue for the soda machine to be clearer.

🗑️ You can no longer set prices on regular trash cans.

⚙️ Fixed coin collection stutter due to performance hiccups.

🧲 Reduced physics knockback caused by cola cans pushing the player.

🎲 Removed small cube markers from in front of Gacha machines.

🖼️ Gacha ball display in 16:10 aspect ratio now renders correctly.

🎯 Gacha machines stacked on top of each other now fill correctly.

🧭 Tutorial pointer is now disabled when the tablet is closed or the player is not in the redemption screen.

🛒 Tutorial Purchase pointer now consistently appears where it should.

📱 If the tablet is open during end-of-day, pressing enter now closes it properly.

📚 Fixed broken Gacha opening tutorial flow (Open → Add to Collection → View → Close).

⏹️ While viewing a Gacha model in the collection app, pressing Escape now exits the viewer and app properly, instead of opening the pause menu.

Prevented the same NPC model visiting the store multiple times.
[hr][/hr]🔮 What’s Next?
Patch 0.2.0 is just the beginning of the feature phase of development. 

Stay tuned for future updates including in the next update:

Machine repair system

Store customization (flooring & walls)

Reworked Renovation App
[hr][/hr]
Thank you again for being part of this incredible journey. Your feedback is what drives this project forward.
💬 Join the discussion and help shape the game:
👉 https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx

We're just getting started — and the arcade is only going to get wilder from here. 🎮

notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator – Demo Patch v0.1.5
notes.content:
Hey Arcade Owners!

We’re thrilled to bring you Patch v0.1.5, a significant quality-of-life update that smooths out gameplay, fixes bugs, and improves core systems — all based on your awesome feedback.

Thank you for continuing to support us and helping shape the future of Arcade Management Simulator. We’re just warming up, and the next update will be our first major feature drop, but more on that at the end!
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Major Fixes & Changes
⏳ Redemption Queue Timeout
Customers waiting more than 1 hour at the redemption counter will now leave the queue, and you’ll earn reduced XP for delayed service.

📦 Sell Machines / Box Up Feature Added
You can now box up or sell machines directly from your arcade — time to declutter and earn back some cash!

🎓 Gacha Tutorial Moved to Day 1
The Gacha tutorial now triggers after the ticket and coin collection tutorial — for a smoother learning flow.

⚙️ Settings Menu Bug Fixed
Changing settings now properly applies changes across all game systems. Your preferences will stick as expected!
[hr][/hr]🧰 Minor Fixes & Tweaks
🕹️ Updated tutorial to instruct players to go to the machine with the exclamation mark (Ninja Fighter).

🚶‍♂️ Increased walking speed to 6 for faster arcade navigation.

🪟 Fixed issue where Gacha machines appeared transparent when viewed from outside the arcade.

📱 Tablet apps enabled with proper overlays now active.

🏷️ Increased sticker size on refill boxes. Changed quantity display format to: 8/15. Switched color to black for better readability.

🥷 Ninja Fighter machine now starts at 70% full on Day 1.

❌ Replaced “Collect them all” prompt in Gacha with a new prompt: "Press ESC to leave the Gacha Machine."

🖱️ Added tooltip: "Click and hold left click inside the green highlight to collect coins from the Gacha Machine."

🖱️ Fixed bug where the mouse pointer disappeared if you were at the redemption counter and the day ended. It now stays visible.

💚 Adjusted green coin highlight to avoid overlapping with Gacha characters (based on your video feedback).

🚪 Fixed issue where customers walked through closed doors after redeeming tickets post-day-end.

🗑️ Trash bin can no longer be placed or moved while in the redemption screen.

🗑️ Fixed bug where selecting Q on the trash bin duplicated it in multiple places.
[hr][/hr]🔮 Coming Soon: First Feature Update
Get ready — our next major update will introduce new gameplay systems and deeper arcade management tools. Here's what to expect in Patch v0.2.0:

🏪 Retail System Revamp – Overhauled backend for smoother store operations.

🏦 Bank Loan App – Take loans to expand your arcade empire.

🌟 Customer Reviews System – Hear what players love (and hate) about your arcade.

🛠️ Machine Repair System – Fix up broken machines to avoid downtime.

🎨 Store Customization – Personalize your arcade with flooring and wall options!
[hr][/hr]
Thank you again for being part of this journey. Your feedback continues to shape the game and push it forward. We’re just getting started — and the best is yet to come!

👉 Join our official Discord community to share your ideas, report bugs, and hang out with fellow arcade enthusiasts:
🔗 

https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx



Until next time — keep managing and keep playing! 🕹️
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator – Demo Update v0.1.4
notes.content:
Hey Arcade Managers!

We’re back with another important update to improve your arcade-running experience. Version 0.1.4 focuses on fixing persistent Gacha issues, improving tutorial clarity, smoothing out UI feedback, and introducing some quality-of-life upgrades — all thanks to your continued support and suggestions!

As always, a massive thank you for being part of this journey. Your feedback during and after Steam Next Fest has been incredible. Keep it coming!
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Major Fixes & Improvements
🎰 Top Gacha Fixes

Top-row Gacha machines are now movable again.

Gacha machines on top no longer go missing after saving and reloading.

Fixed an exploit that let players duplicate Gacha machines when snapping one next to another.

🎵 Consistent Music Volume

Game and pause menu music volumes now match.

Both soundtracks are now normalized for consistent in-game audio levels.

⏭️ Gacha Interaction Fix

Ending the day mid-Gacha opening will now correctly exit Gacha mode the next day instead of opening the pause menu.

🟩 Better Visual Feedback

Gacha machines now show a green outline when needing a refill or coin collection.

Vending machines now have a coin box highlight for easier coin collection.

🖥️ Toggle Fullscreen Button Activated

You can now toggle fullscreen mode directly from the settings menu.

🖱️ Pointer & End-of-Day Screen UI Fixes

The circle pointer no longer disappears after the day ends.

End-of-day message has been moved lower to avoid blocking interaction.
[hr][/hr]🧰 Smaller Fixes & Tweaks
Disabled Miscellaneous and Sort buttons in the Online Shop.

Disabled all "Coming Soon" apps in the tablet.

Changed font color for level requirements in the Online Shop for better clarity.

Updated ticket redemption tutorial text to include “(or more)”.

Made tutorial arrows larger and placed them in more visible spots.

Gacha refill and soda can refill now display the number of products per box.

Tutorial now clarifies: "Click and hold" when inserting tickets.

Reduced number of customers at the redemption counter on Day 1.

Ensured Ninja Fighter machine fills up first on Day 1 instead of Gacha.

Added a prompt to show ‘C’ for crouch when near a Gacha machine.

Reduced cost of the Trash Can.

Disabled all Auction buttons in the My Gacha Collection app.
[hr][/hr]🔮 Coming Soon in v0.1.5
We're already working hard on the next update! Here's a sneak peek:

🕒 Customers at the redemption counter will leave if waiting more than 1 hour, and you’ll earn reduced XP for delayed service.

🏷️ The long-awaited Sell Machines feature is on the way!
[hr][/hr]
Once again, thank you for being an essential part of the Arcade Management Simulator community. Your support has been incredible — and we’re just getting started! Tons of exciting features, customizations, and systems are on the horizon. 🚀

👉 Join our official Discord to share your thoughts, report bugs, and be part of the journey:
🔗 

https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx

Until next time — keep those tokens rolling! 🕹️

notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator Demo - Update v0.1.3
notes.content:
Hey Arcade Managers!

We’re back with a major update (v0.1.3) packed with important fixes and new features — and we want to start by saying thank you for the incredible support you’ve shown us, especially during last week’s Steam Next Fest. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re excited to keep building this game with you!

This update focuses on improving game stability, adding a long-requested Settings Menu, and fixing several issues related to saving, UI scaling, machine behavior, and more.
🛠️ Patch Notes – Demo v0.1.3
🖥️ Dynamic UI Scaling
The UI now automatically adjusts to your screen resolution, improving playability across devices.

⚙️ New Settings Menu Added

Adjust screen resolution

Change music and SFX volumes

Tweak mouse sensitivity

💡 Coin Box Highlights
Always-on coin box highlights for Samurai Legend, Robot Revolt, and Dungeon Quest have been disabled for better visual clarity.

❗ Machine Exclamation Issue Fixed
Exclamation icons now persist correctly across days and saves — no more disappearing alerts on full machines.

🕘 Post-9PM Save Bug Fixed
Saving the game after 9PM and reloading no longer prevents progression — the end-of-day sequence now triggers correctly.

💳 Billing System Fixed
Billing logic has been corrected to reflect accurate financial tracking and deductions.

🎰 Faster Gacha Animation
Gacha opening animations are now faster and snappier for a smoother experience.

🧹 Proper Game Reset
The game now resets all states correctly when starting a new session, ensuring a clean slate each time.

🧱 Object Placement Issue in Tutorial Fixed
You can now move and place objects freely after the tutorial, even outside the highlighted area.

🕔 Store Status Bug Fixed
After saving and reloading, the store status now reflects properly (no more “Closed” signs with active customers).

💸 Machine Prices Now Save Correctly
Pricing for machines will persist properly across sessions.

📊 Daily Report Stats Fixed
Daily report data now displays and calculates correctly after saving and continuing.

🎵 Music Volume Fix
Music now maintains your set volume even after exiting the pause or settings menu — no more unexpected volume jumps!
[hr][/hr]🔮 Coming Soon in the Next Update
We're already working on the next update! Here's what to expect:

🔁 Gacha Replication Bug Fix
Gacha machines placed on top rows will save and function properly.

🧩 Gacha Placement Improvements
Gachas set on elevated rows will be movable without issues.

🏪 Retail Store Expansion Revamp
We’re laying the groundwork for a revamped store system and a brand-new customization menu.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you again for being part of this amazing journey. We’re just getting started — and we’ve got some exciting features and surprises lined up for the future. 🚀

👉 Join our official Discord to share your feedback, get sneak peeks, and connect with other players:
🔗 

https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx



Let’s keep building the ultimate arcade together! 🕹️

notes.title: Arcade Management Simulator Demo - Update 0.1.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First off, a huge thank you to all of you who’ve played the demo, shared feedback, and supported the game so far. It’s been amazing to see your excitement and we’re incredibly grateful for the community growing around Arcade Management Simulator!

We’ve just pushed Update 0.1.1 for the demo with a few key fixes based directly on your feedback:
🔧 Patch Notes – Demo v0.1.1
